QuestInfo.name: Mysteries of Cosmic Green
QuestInfo.0: Cassandra wants to tell you something about the Cosmic Green...
QuestInfo.1: The green gauge fills up by attacking monsters in a certain area while having the Cosmic Green in your Set-up inventory. #bOnce you charge it with 500 hits, you can activate the Going Green skill by using the Attack Key.#k By clicking on the Event Notifier on the left side of the screen, you can view a list of hunting grounds to charge your Cosmic Green in.
QuestInfo.2: Cassandra told you that the green gauge would fill up by attacking monsters in a certain areas while having the Cosmic Green in your Set-up inventory. After 500 hits, you can activate Going Green with the Attack Key. By clicking on the Event Notifier on the left side of the screen, you can see a list of hunting grounds to charge your Cosmic Green in.
QuestInfo.demandSummary: Activate the Going Green skill once

0.0: #b#h0##k, how are you handling your Cosmic Green? I told you how to use it, but I want to make sure you're comfortable with its awesome power. Do you want more info?

yes.0: Okay, so, let's start at the beginning. Collect energy from monsters by hitting them with regular attacks. The Cosmic Green will convert this energy into pure green star energy. Once you have enough, release it in the form of the Going Green skill!\n\nYou can see a list of hunting grounds to charge your Cosmic Green in the #rCosmic Green Field Info#k. Click on the Event Notifier on the left side of the screen to check it. Fill up your Cosmic Green, and use the #bGoing Green#k skill once. That's your mission, brave Eco Mapleteer!

no.0: Well...good! I'm glad you're so comfortable with it. Let me know if you change your mind, though.

default.0: I know you haven't used the Going Green skill yet. Don't try to trick me!
